book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Luka

content: Yecho ihaghuu bhabholwa bha kutumbula
Lichiko limo, Yecho pakibha ajhemite pahina jha lilabha lya ku Genechalete, lilongo lya bhando lijhakuntindikiya na kukangana kangana, bhajhokanikiya lilobhe lya Chapanga.
Ajhakuhibhona ngalabha ibhele ijhebhelekiwe pahina jha lilabha, na bhapyeya homba bhene bhalenganikiya lwaho yabhe.

Yecho ajhakujhingii mungalabha jha mundo jhumo liina lyake Simone, ajhakunnobholela aheghekeye pupamila pandina kuhumii kupele mwa lilabha. Yecho ajhakutama mungalabha mwenio na kubhola lilongo lya bhando.
Pajhomolila kubhola, ajhakunobholela Simone, “Nheghekeye ngalabha jhino pupanyolike hake, peniya mukahuluhe lwaho lwino lwa kupyeke homba na ntumbula kupyeya.”
Simone ajhakujhanguu, “Bhambo, tughaghite kuhenga lihengo kilo jhoha kibhii jhe kilebhe chitujhambulile. Nambo nhwalo gwa mwenga nnongile, nahuluwa lwaho.”
Peniya pibhahulwiha lwaho lwabhe, ndi bhajhakuponga homba yamahele hake, ade lwaho lujhakutwelela na kutumbuu kunochokana.
Bhajhakwakema bhajhabhe bhibhakibha mungalabha jhenge, bhahike kwatangatila. Bhakahikite, bhajhakutweleya ngalabha yoha ibhele homba ade ngalabha ipata kumilwa.
Simone Petile palolita gheniya, ajhakutama makilikite palonge jha Yecho alongila, “Bhambo mmoke palonge jhango, nenga ngwete uhakaho!”
Simone pamonga na bhajhake bhakahechwike kwa kuponga homba twe ngita yenio.

Helahela Yakobu na Yohane yana ya Chebedayo, bhibhakibha akakoche bha Simone, na bhene bhakahechwike. Yecho pannobholila Simone, “Nkotoka kulendema, kuhumii ngoheno na kujhendelela namapyeha bhando ngita chimuleta homba ukajha.”
Bhahe, pibhajhomolila kubheka ngalabha yabhe muupele jha mulilabha, bhajhakubhoka bhoha na kunkengama Bhambo Yecho.
Yecho inamicha mundo jhuna malohe

Lichiko limo Yecho akibha ku muche ghumo gwa kwenio, mundo jhumo jhuna malohe yegha jhoha ajhakunhikilila. Pamonita Yecho ajhakukigwiya pahe mangukama na kunnobholela, “Bhambo, anda uhoto kunyelebhula, unyelebhulajhe!”
Yecho ajhakuhatambuu lubhoko lwake na kumpapaha na kulonge “Nipala, nnyelebhuke!” Papalapala malohe ghajhakummoka.

Yecho ajhakunaghalakiya, “Nkotoka kunnobhole mundo jhojhoha, nambo nnyende mukakilangiye kwa mupiya litambiko jwa Chapanga, na mpeleke litambiko lino kwa nhwalo gwa kujhelebhuka kwino ngita chalaghalikie Mucha nhwalo gwa kwalangii bhando bhoha nnamite.”
Nambo lilobhe lya Yecho lijhakuchocha kuchobhela poha, bhando bhamahele hake bhajhakukonganika kujhokanikiya na kulamichwa malwalo gwabhe.
Nambo Yecho pipipi ajhahwila chehemo jhanga bhando, kwa nhwalo gwa kunnyopa Chapanga.
Yecho inamicha mundo jwatengwike

Lichiko limo, Yecho pakibha mukubhola, Mapwalichayo bhange na bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo, kuhumii mukila chenda jha ku Galilaya na ku Yudeya na ku Yeluchalemo bhakatamite pamonga. Na makakala gha Bhambo ghajhakubhehe pamonga na jwenio, kwa kulamicha bhibhalwalwa.
Ndi papa bhajhakuhika bhando bhangheghite mundo jwatengwike yegha jhoha mu nchekacheka, bhapata kujhinginako nkate, bhameke palonge jha Yecho.

Nambo nhwalo gwa kujholoka kwa bhando, bhakahotwii ndeka kujhingii nako nkate. Bhahe, bhajhakuhobhokela ku kipaghalo kupekenyela lihoto bhajhakuhuluwa pamonga na nchekacheka gwake, bhajhakumeka palonge jha Yecho.
Yecho palolita kihobholelo chabhe, ajhakunongolela jwalwalwa jhola, “Makoche bhango, nnekekiwe uhakaho gwino.”
Mapwalichayo na bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo, bhajhakutumbuu kukikonya, “Mwe maghane jhumunigha Chapanga! Abhii jhe mundo jwahoto kulekekeya uhakaho nga Chapanga kanjika!”
Yecho akamanye chibhahola ngakonyita, “Nhwalo gwa nike miwacha gheniya kumiojho jhino?
Nike chikijhojwike kulonge, ‘Uhakaho gwino ulekekiwe,’ amu kulonge, ‘Nnyeme ntyange?’

Bhahe, nipala umanye kubhehe Mwana gwa Mundo akwete ukindendeke pannema gwa kulekekeya bhando uhakaho gwabhe.” Ajhakunnobholela jwatengwike jhola, “Ninobholela jhema, tola kindengato chino, nnyende kajhino!”
Papalapala mundo jhola ajhekujhema palonge jha bhando bhoha, ajhakuto mpacha gwake na kujhenda kajhake kone annombita Chapanga.
Bhando bhoha bhakahechwike na kubhehe na bwaghaliya. Bhajhakunomba Chapanga, bhalongila, “Deleno tuibhwene ilebhe yakukangacha!”
Yecho inkema Lawe
Pighapetita gheniya, Yecho akapita panja na kumwona ntola kode jhumo liina lyake Lawe, jwatamita panyumba jha kulepe kode. Bhahe, Yecho ajhakunobholela, “Hika ungengame.”
Jwenio ajhakuleka kila kilebhe, na kukengama.
Peniya, Lawe ajhakutendela unyagho nkolongwa gwa kulyegha Yecho kajhake, na lilongo lya akatola kode na bhando bhange bhakatamite pamonga nabho.
Nambo Mapwalichayo na bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo bhajhakwakokolekeya bhabholwa bhake Yecho, bhalongila, “Bho, nhwalo gwa nike mulye na kunywegha pamonga na akatola kode na bhibhabhii na uhakaho?”
Yecho pabhalongolila, “Bhando bhangalwalwa bhipala ndeka nghanga, nambo bhibhalwalwa nabhampala nghanga.
Nenga hikite jhe kwakema bhando bhaumbone bhangengame palonge jha Chapanga, nambo bhando bhibhabhii akahakaho, bhauleke na kughalambukila Chapanga.”
Yecho ilonge kupunga
Bhando bhange bhannobholila Yecho, “Bhabholwa bha Yohane Mbatichajhe na bha Mapwalichayo pipipi bhakibha bhapungite kulyegha na bhanyopita Chapanga. Nambo bhabholwa bhino bhikapii tugha.”
Yecho ajhakwajhanguu, “Bho, bhibhalalikwe kuunyagho gwa ndowa nnyinamwale munalome bhala paunyagho bhaleka kulyegha pubhabhehe pamonga na jwenio? Naha ndeka!
Nambo machiko ghabhikuhika gha nyinamwale munalome kubhoka pakate jhabhe, peniya ndi nabhapunga kulyegha.”

Yecho ajhakwalobholela nnandanikiho ghongo, “Abhii jhe mundo jwajwepula kibhambo cha ngobho yono na kuchonolela mukindukotuko. Anda atenda naha, najwepula ngobho nhyono na kibhambo nakiwanana ndeka na ngobho jhela jhitukutwike.
Abhii jhe mundo jwabheka divaye hyono mulihako lilitukutwike lya limbendela. Anda ateii naha, divaye nhyono nahijwepula lihako lyenio na kujhitika.
Nambo divaye nhyono ubhekwa mulihako lya limbendela lya kubheke divaye nhyono.
Abhii jhe mundo jwaipala kunywehe divaye nhyono anda akayobhalile kunywe jha makacho! Nhwalo ulonge ‘Jha makacho ndi lwengo hake.’ ”
